# Bean Bloom Coffee (晨光咖啡)

> Small-batch roasted coffee beans, shipped from Yunnan.
> Agent-only shop. Demo only — no real orders, no real payments.
> Shop URL: https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/

## Entry points
- [Agent card](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/agent.json)
- [Agent card (well-known)](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/.well-known/agent.json)
- [OpenAPI](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/openapi.json)
- [Full corpus](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/llms-full.txt)
- [Catalog](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/api/catalog.json)
- [Products](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/api/products.json)
- [Policies](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/policies.json)
- [MCP descriptor](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/bean-bloom/mcp.json)

## What this shop sells
- Yirgacheffe Light Roast 250g — 68 CNY, stock 42. Floral, citrus, light roast. Whole bean.
- Cold Brew Blend 500g — 88 CNY, stock 27. Chocolate, nutty, low acidity. For cold brew.
- Decaf Medium Roast 250g — 72 CNY, stock 0. Swiss Water decaf. Out of stock in this demo.

## How to interact
- Read-only first: GET {shop}/api/products.json, then GET {shop}/policies.json.
- In production: POST {shop}/mcp, Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18. Tools: list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. See mcp.json.
- On GitHub Pages the MCP endpoint is documented only — Pages is static-only. See platform README.md.
- create_order is a mock in this demo. Send an idempotency_key. Never charge a real card from demo data.
